detail: What can be checked without the store artefacts: the mobile web bundle (vite --mode mobile, what Capacitor copies into the app) has key/credential hits: none; server canaries baked: none. The TestFlight IPA and the Play AAB/APK themselves are not scanned (needs the CI artefacts from Tim, plus apktool/aapt, not installed).
